paragraphs: The M4 GTS uses the S55 — a 3.0-litre twin-turbo straight-six, shared with the contemporary M4, M4 Competition and M4 CS. What sets the GTS apart is its water-injection system, which sprays a fine mist of water into the intake plenum to cool the charge air and allow higher boost pressures. It was fitted only to the F82-generation GTS in 2016, as a limited-run special — the M4 GTS was never carried over to the G82 generation. The S55's press-fit crank hub is the engine's single well-documented weak point under hard use, and we address it as standard on every rebuild.
about.boldParagraph: The M4 GTS is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
